name: Robledillo de la Jara (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, red and green with a broad red stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Robledillo de la Jara (a tree on yellow and a bend with the words AVE MARIA).
history: Municipal flag of Robledillo de la Jara; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Robledillo de la Jara arms — tree on yellow and bend with the words AVE MARIA
